# @washy-washy/pdf

> The `@react-pdf/renderer` components that draw a laundry chart into a PDF —
> the phone sheet, the print sheet, and the per-pile reference cards — plus
> the layout-fitting logic that bisects each one until it lands on exactly
> one page. Published to npm as `@washy-washy/pdf`, licensed
> GPL-3.0-or-later.

It renders a resolved chart from [`@washy-washy/core`](https://github.com/alrayyes/washy-washy-core)
against a `Machine` description of the washer and iron it's drawn for.
`renderPhone`, `renderPrint`, and `renderCard` are the main entry points;
`PhoneDocument`, `PrintDocument`, `ReferenceDocument`, and `CardDocument`
are exported directly for use with a caller's own
`@react-pdf/renderer` pipeline. This is the rendering half of
[washy-washy-cli](https://github.com/alrayyes/washy-washy-cli), split out
so it can be depended on without the CLI's Bun-specific tooling.

## Docs

- [API reference](https://alrayyes.github.io/washy-washy-pdf/): every
  export, its signature, and a runnable example, generated with TypeDoc.
- [README](https://github.com/alrayyes/washy-washy-pdf#readme):
  installation, usage, and the rendered example sheets.
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/alrayyes/washy-washy-pdf/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md):
  commands, linters, tests, git hooks, and how a release is cut.

- [npm: @washy-washy/pdf](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@washy-washy/pdf):
  install and version history.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/alrayyes/washy-washy-pdf): issues,

## Related

- [@washy-washy/core](https://alrayyes.github.io/washy-washy-core/): the
  data half — chart parsing, mixing rules, machine validation — that this
  package renders.
- [washy-washy-cli](https://github.com/alrayyes/washy-washy-cli): the CLI
  this package's rendering was split out of.
